How it works

Three steps, no forms

  • Add the devices your team needs to the basket, mixing and matching any models
  • The tier is calculated on the total number of devices and applied at checkout
  • Everything ships free, with the same warranty and returns as a single unit

Prefer to pay by bank transfer, or want one unit to trial before the rest? Ask for a quote and we will send a proforma invoice and complete your supplier forms. Buying regularly? Apply for a trade account to order on invoice.

The range

What to put in the basket

Our pick for most teams is the 10.1 inch Android A10, with the W10 for anyone whose software only runs on Windows. The 6 inch A6, with its built-in barcode scanner, suits people who need a device in a pocket more than a screen for drawings.

Fleet order or framework agreement?

If you are buying for more than fifty devices, or need staged delivery, asset tagging or a specific configuration, email us and we will work it out properly.
